response:
2, air, O2) | In | Gas supply to FCV-510, FCV-511, FCV-512. The utility module owns supply pressure alarms. |
| Batch historian and event journal | Out | Setpoint-change records, base total, mode and probe-selection events |
| Alarm system | Out | Alarms in Section 7 |

**Out of scope:** temperature, foam, vessel pressure, feed, harvest, and any SIS function. Any safety instrumented function belongs in the SRS (OI-11).

## 3. States and transitions

### 3.1 Phase activity

| Batch phase | Module state | pH loop | DO loop |
|---|---|---|---|
| Media Fill | Idle | Out of service | Out of service |
| Equilibrate | Running | Auto | Auto |
| Inoculate | Running | Auto | Auto |
| Production | Running | Auto | Auto |
| Harvest | Complete, then Idle | Out of service | Out of service |

### 3.2 States

| State | Loops | Outputs |
|---|---|---|
| Idle | Out of service | FCV-510 closed, FCV-512 closed, P-520 off. FCV-511 and SIC-530 not commanded. |
| Running | Auto. The operator may select Manual. | Set by the loops (Section 4) |
| Holding, Held | Unchanged. Only the recipe pauses. | Same as Running |
| Restarting | Unchanged | Same as Running |
| Held after power restore | Manual | FCV-510 closed, FCV-512 closed, P-520 off |
| Complete, Stopping, Stopped | Out of service | SEQ-2 |
| Aborting, Aborted | Out of service | Immediate safe state |

**Safe state:** FCV-510 closed, FCV-512 closed, P-520 off. FCV-511 and SIC-530 are released and hold their last value.

### 3.3 Transitions

| ID | From → To | Initiator | Condition | Automation level | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-BR500-001 | Idle → Running | Recipe | Equilibrate starts and SEQ-1 completes. A start in Media Fill or Harvest is rejected. | Automatic | T |
| FR-BR500-002 | Running → Holding → Held | Operator, batch, or module hold request | None. Loops and outputs continue unchanged. | Automatic or operator | T |
| FR-BR500-003 | Held → Restarting → Running | Operator | Permissives of SEQ-1 step 1 are true | Operator-prompted | T |
| FR-BR500-004 | Running → Complete | Recipe | Production ends. SEQ-2 runs. | Automatic | T |
| FR-BR500-005 | Running or Held → Stopping → Stopped | Operator | SEQ-2 runs | Manual | T |
| FR-BR500-006 | Any active state → Aborting → Aborted | Operator or batch | Safe state within RESP_T | Manual | T |
| FR-BR500-007 | Complete, Stopped, Aborted → Idle | Operator or batch | Reset command. Base total resets only on a new batch ID. | Manual | T |
| FR-BR500-008 | Power restore → Held | Automatic | State was Running, Holding or Held before the loss. SEQ-3 runs. | Operator-prompted | T |
| FR-BR500-009 | Any non-Active state | Automatic | The outputs in 3.2 apply. Attempts to set a loop to Auto are rejected. | Automatic | T |

| FR-BR500-012 | Inside the deadband both pH outputs are zero and both integrators hold. The acid and base loops never act together. | T |

## 5. Sequences

Derive one OQ test per step: the pass path and the forced failure.

### SEQ-1 Activate (FR-BR500-025)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check permissives: one healthy AT-501, one healthy AT-502, WT-521 good, SIC-530 running, no actuator fault | All true | PERM_TO | AL-19, request Hold, stay in step |
| 2 | If no base total exists, store BASE_REF from WT-521 and set BASE_ACC to zero | WT-521 stable | PERM_TO | Disable base side (IL-02), AL-10, go to step 3 |
| 3 | Load PH_SP, PH_DB, DO_SP from the recipe | Values valid and within entry limits | STEP_TO | AL-19, request Hold, loops stay Manual |
| 4 | Start pH loop in Auto | Mode is Auto | STEP_TO | AL-19, loops stay Manual |
| 5 | Set DO demand to match SIC-530 speed. Start DO loop in Auto. | Mode is Auto | STEP_TO | AL-19, loops stay Manual |

### SEQ-2 Deactivate (FR-BR500-026)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stop P-520. Close FCV-510. | Both confirmed | CLOSE_TO | AL-21, go to step 2 |
| 2 | Close FCV-512 | Confirmed closed | CLOSE_TO | AL-21, go to step 3 |
| 3 | Release FCV-511 and SIC-530 | Released | STEP_TO | AL-21, go to step 4 |
| 4 | Write base total and final state to the batch record | Record confirmed | STEP_TO | AL-23, keep value in retentive memory |

On Abort, steps 1 to 3 run at once without waiting for confirmation.

### SEQ-3 Restart after power loss (FR-BR500-027)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Set loops to Manual with safe outputs. Enter Held. | State is Held | STEP_TO | Stay in safe state, AL-22 |
| 2 | Check the permissives of SEQ-1 step 1 | All true | PERM_TO | Stay Held, AL-19 |
| 3 | Compare WT-521 with the retained expected weight | Difference within WT_RECON_TOL | PERM_TO | Disable base side (IL-02), AL-10, go to step 4 |
| 4 | Show prompt PR-05 | Operator pushes RESUME | RESUME_TO | Repeat prompt, raise AL-22 priority, stay Held |
| 5 | Set loops to Auto with retained setpoints | Mode is Auto | STEP_TO | AL-19, stay Held |

### SEQ-4 Setpoint change (FR-BR500-028)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Operator enters the new value | Value within entry limits | REASON_TO | Reject, keep old value |
| 2 | Show prompt PR-04. Operator selects a reason. | Reason entered ("Other" needs a comment) | REASON_TO | Cancel, keep old value, log the cancellation |
| 3 | Write the record: batch ID, phase, parameter, old value, new value, time, user, reason | Record confirmed | STEP_TO | AL-23, keep old value |
| 4 | Apply the new value | Loop setpoint equals new value | STEP_TO | Revert to old value, AL-23 |

### SEQ-5 Base bag change (FR-BR500-029)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Operator pushes BAG CHANGE START. Stop P-520. Lock the base side. Set BASE_ACC to the current base total. | P-520 stopped | STEP_TO | AL-21 |
| 2 | Operator replaces the bag and pushes BAG CHANGED (PR-01) | Button pushed | BAG_TO | Keep base side locked, AL-11, repeat prompt |
| 3 | Wait for WT-521 to be stable | Stable | PERM_TO | Keep base side locked, AL-10 |
| 4 | Set BASE_REF to the new weight. Record old total, new weight and user. | Record confirmed | STEP_TO | Keep base side locked, AL-23 |
| 5 | Unlock the base side | Interlocks IL-01 to IL-03 clear | STEP_TO | AL-19 |
